field: 1300 pixel native-resolution square; use catalogue cone radius 15 arcmin, within provider warning threshold
calibration: Quadratic magnitude versus log10 signed positive local density sum, robust three-MAD training outlier rejection, derivative must remain monotonic; reject target extrapolation
withheld_control_gate: At least 12 valid leave-one-out predictions, median absolute residual <=0.25 mag; target magnitude plus/minus empirical held-out residual quantiles and blank-aperture noise are descriptive, not all systematic uncertainty
target_detection: Signal must exceed five times robust scatter of blank-aperture sums. Negative/weak signals retained rather than clipped.
comparison_safety: No target values in fit or scan-polarity choice. Catalogue controls selected before measuring target. Proper position and expected normal brightness will be checked against static catalogue and local astrometry.
corroboration_gate: At least two physically separate event plates satisfy model/position/signal support and show dimming exceeding both 0.2 mag and three times held-out control RMS; aperture sensitivities must have consistent sign. This is conservative pilot screening, not a formal combined significance.
control_magnitude_window: Catalogue natural magnitude within 1.5 mag of target expected magnitude, selected before examining cutout measurements
